description: Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) is half the number of words of length 4*n over the alphabet [4] such that c(2) = c(3) = c(4), any prefix satisfies c(1) >= c(2), c(1) >= c(3), c(2) >= c(4), c(3) >= c(4), no proper prefix satisfies c(1) = c(2) = c(3) = c(4), and the maximum value of c(1) - c(4) = k for some prefix. Here c(i) is the number of occurrences of the letter i.
